required_flow: Its callback advances to ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION on API>=33 regardless of microphone grant.
Return requires Environment.isExternalStorageManager() true, otherwise Permission denied dialog.
Success proceeds to preparation/chooser/launch; chooser task is removed only after requesting selected experience launch.
qualification_rule: No blind relaunch; fresh measured UI and actual grant/lifecycle evidence must distinguish setup from native execution.
